problem_type: Media feedback and shot numbering compete for the same visual region.
symptom: Saved status overlaps the shot number.
direct_cause: Shot number does not account for transient feedback.
class_root: Status and shot number have no distinct permanent spatial owners.
affected_population: Image and video generation, including persisted errors
internal_only_reason: Internal presentation and error contracts; no external protocol.

generality_proof: Enforced in shared production boundaries for every image/video caller.
